nodes.description: Public view function getDerivedPrice(address _base, address _quote, uint8 _decimals) that queries two caller-supplied Chainlink aggregators and returns a derived price.
Internal pure function scalePrice(int256 _price, uint8 _priceDecimals, uint8 _decimals) that rescales a price to the requested decimals.
Parameter _base: caller-controlled address used as the base price oracle, cast to AggregatorV3Interface and called externally.
Parameter _quote: caller-controlled address used as the quote price oracle, cast to AggregatorV3Interface and called externally.
Parameter _decimals of getDerivedPrice, validated to be in (0, 18] and used to build the 10 ** _decimals scaling factor.
Local variable decimals = int256(10 ** uint256(_decimals)), the fixed-point scaling factor used in the final multiplication.
Local variable basePrice: raw answer from the base oracle, later overwritten with the scaled value returned by scalePrice.
Local variable baseDecimals: decimals() reported by the base oracle contract and used as _priceDecimals.
Local variable quotePrice: raw answer from the quote oracle, later overwritten with the scaled value returned by scalePrice; used as the divisor.
Local variable quoteDecimals: decimals() reported by the quote oracle contract.
External call AggregatorV3Interface(_base).latestRoundData() on a caller-supplied address; returned answer/updatedAt are not validated for staleness or positivity.
External call AggregatorV3Interface(_base).decimals() on a caller-supplied address; unbounded return value flows into the scaling computation.
External call AggregatorV3Interface(_quote).latestRoundData() on a caller-supplied address; answer is used directly as a divisor.
External call AggregatorV3Interface(_quote).decimals() on a caller-supplied address; unbounded return value flows into the scaling computation.
Arithmetic expression basePrice * decimals / quotePrice: unchecked int256 multiplication overflow and division by zero / precision loss when quotePrice is zero or tiny.
Parameter _price of scalePrice: the oracle-reported price value to be rescaled.
Parameter _priceDecimals of scalePrice: decimals reported by the oracle, controls which branch executes.
Parameter _decimals of scalePrice: target decimals used as the branch comparison and exponent base.
Arithmetic _price * int256(10 ** uint256(_decimals - _priceDecimals)) in scalePrice: unchecked multiplication overflow and uint8 subtraction under its guard.
Arithmetic _price / int256(10 ** uint256(_priceDecimals - _decimals)) in scalePrice: integer division truncation of the price.

edges.reason: Caller-supplied _base is cast to AggregatorV3Interface and invoked externally, letting attacker-controlled code execute during latestRoundData().
Caller-supplied _quote is cast to AggregatorV3Interface and invoked externally, letting attacker-controlled code execute during latestRoundData().
getDerivedPrice executes the external latestRoundData() call on the base oracle.
getDerivedPrice executes the external decimals() call on the base oracle.
getDerivedPrice executes the external latestRoundData() call on the quote oracle.
getDerivedPrice executes the external decimals() call on the quote oracle.
Oracle answer returned by latestRoundData() is assigned to local basePrice.
Oracle decimals() return value is assigned to local baseDecimals.
Oracle answer returned by latestRoundData() is assigned to local quotePrice.
Oracle decimals() return value is assigned to local quoteDecimals.
Parameter _decimals is used to compute the scaling factor decimals = 10 ** _decimals.
basePrice is an operand of the unchecked multiplication basePrice * decimals.
Scaling factor decimals is an operand of the unchecked multiplication, enabling overflow on large prices.
quotePrice is the divisor in basePrice * decimals / quotePrice; a zero or tiny value causes division by zero or truncation.
Result of the arithmetic expression is returned by getDerivedPrice.
getDerivedPrice calls internal scalePrice to normalize both oracle price values.
Scaled base price returned by scalePrice is written back into local basePrice.
Scaled quote price returned by scalePrice is written back into local quotePrice.
_price is multiplied by a power-of-ten factor, which can overflow int256.
_priceDecimals drives the branch and the uint8 subtraction _decimals - _priceDecimals used as exponent.
_decimals determines the exponent and the branch condition in the expansion path.
Expanded value is returned by scalePrice.
_price is divided by a power-of-ten factor, causing rounding/truncation in the shrink path.
_priceDecimals drives the branch and the uint8 subtraction _priceDecimals - _decimals used as exponent.
_decimals determines the exponent and the branch condition in the shrink path.
Shrunk value is returned by scalePrice.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _base is only used to select and invoke the external oracle contract represented by the unsafe operation node.
Parameter _quote is only used to select and invoke the external oracle contract represented by the unsafe operation node.
Parameter _decimals feeds the scaling factor used in the final multiplication/division arithmetic operation.
Local decimals is a temporary scaling factor that exists solely as an operand of the derived-price arithmetic.
Local basePrice is the oracle-derived value consumed by the arithmetic operation that produces the return value.
Local baseDecimals is only forwarded as the _priceDecimals argument to the internal scalePrice call.
Local quotePrice is the oracle-derived divisor of the arithmetic operation producing the return value.
Local quoteDecimals is only forwarded as the _priceDecimals argument to the internal scalePrice call.
Parameter _price is the direct operand of the multiplication arithmetic in the expansion branch of scalePrice.
Parameter _priceDecimals decides the branch and forms the exponent subtraction for the division arithmetic in scalePrice.
Parameter _decimals of scalePrice sets the exponent compared against _priceDecimals in the expansion arithmetic.
